# BINO

> Building Intelligence & Operations — מערכת ניהול פרויקטים, בניינים ושטחים עם זיכרון תפעולי בישראל.

BINO is not a generic ticketing system and not committee-only (ועד בית) software. It learns from ticket history, equipment, vendors, costs, and resolution times per project/site; recommends the right worker or vendor; detects recurring failures; alerts on SLA risk; and proves time and money saved for Israeli management companies running buildings, spaces, and portfolios.

Primary market: Israel. Primary language: Hebrew.
Primary surface: https://bino.tech/ (Hebrew) and https://bino.tech/en (English).

## Primary URLs

- https://bino.tech/ — Hebrew marketing site (main positioning)
- https://bino.tech/en — English marketing site
- https://bino.tech/guides — Hebrew operational guides for management companies
- https://bino.tech/savings-report — Sample savings report (lead magnet)
- https://bino.tech/vaad-pay — Public Grow payment page (per-tenant)
- https://bino.tech/contact — Contact (NAP)
- https://bino.tech/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://bino.tech/terms — Terms of service

## North-star product metrics

1. זמן עד שיוך (time to assignment)
2. זמן עד פתרון (time to resolution)
3. שיעור תקלות חוזרות (recurring-failure rate)
4. עלות תחזוקה לבניין (maintenance cost per building)
5. אחוז התקלות שטופלו ללא התערבות מנהל
